A Basecamp for the

Adopt the pace of nature

A cozy base in the heart of the city — where the rainforest meets urban life. Rain Forest Hotel was born out of a simple belief: that travelers deserve a warm welcome, genuine hospitality, and a comfortable place to rest without exorbitant prices.

Nestled right on historic Jalan Petaling in Chinatown, our restored shophouse offers clean, quiet, air-conditioned rooms, refreshing showers, and a calm courtyard to recharge after exploring Kuala Lumpur.

OUR JOURNEY

How We Got Here

From a small family belief to your cozy urban basecamp in Kuala Lumpur's vibrant Chinatown.

2013

The Beginning

Rain Forest Hotel opened its doors in 2013 with a simple idea: give travellers a calm place to stay surrounded by greenery. It started small, with a handful of rooms and a team that treated every guest like a neighbour. Word spread quickly, and guests kept coming back.

2015

Growing Bigger

Two years in, demand outgrew the original space, so the hotel expanded in 2015. New rooms and upgraded facilities meant more guests could enjoy the same warm welcome. The growth never changed what made the place special, which was the personal touch.

2020

Standing Through the Storm

When the MCO lockdown hit in 2020, travel stopped almost overnight and business slowed to a crawl. It was the hardest year the hotel had faced. The team stayed together, kept the property in shape, and held on until guests could travel again.

2026

Open for a New Chapter

Today, Rain Forest Hotel welcomes guests with the same heart it started with in 2013, now backed by over a decade of experience and a fresh online home. Having come through the tough years, the hotel looks ahead with confidence, ready to host the next generation of travellers.

"We created a sanctuary where you can adopt the pace of nature—a place where travel feels personal, spontaneous, and anchored in community. Here, you can slow down, feel at home, and let your journey unfold naturally."
